CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS visualizations (
  id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  week_of DATE NOT NULL,
  category VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. price_action, on_chain, macro, factor_performance, market_regime, relative_strength, correlation',
  chart_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. line, bar, heatmap, scatter, candlestick',
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  image_url TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT 'S3 CDN URL of the generated chart image',
  data_source VARCHAR(200) COMMENT 'e.g. coingecko, glassnode, fred, tradinghq',
  ai_narration LONGTEXT COMMENT 'Plain-English explanation of what this chart shows and what is notable',
  ai_prediction LONGTEXT COMMENT 'AI interpretation and forward-looking take on the data',
  is_featured TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Whether to include in this weeks montage',
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  INDEX idx_week_of (week_of),
  INDEX idx_category (category)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS montages (
  id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  week_of DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title VARCHAR(500),
  target_duration_seconds INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 600 COMMENT 'Target montage length in seconds',
  visualization_ids TEXT COMMENT 'JSON array of visualization IDs included',
  youtube_clip_urls TEXT COMMENT 'JSON array of YouTube clip URLs curated for this montage',
  youtube_clip_metadata LONGTEXT COMMENT 'JSON array of clip metadata (title, channel, duration, relevance_reason)',
  ai_script LONGTEXT COMMENT 'Full AI-generated script/narration guide for Matthew',
  status ENUM('draft','ready_for_review','reaction_uploaded','published') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  reaction_video_url TEXT COMMENT 'S3 URL of Matthews uploaded reaction video',
  final_video_url TEXT COMMENT 'Final published YouTube video URL',
  youtube_video_id VARCHAR(100),
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  INDEX idx_week_of (week_of)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS x_oauth_tokens (
  id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  account_handle VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. Halfacre_Matt',
  access_token TEXT NOT NULL,
  refresh_token TEXT,
  token_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'bearer',
  expires_at TIMESTAMP,
  scope TEXT COMMENT 'Space-separated OAuth 2.0 scopes',
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY idx_handle (account_handle)
);
